name: r9cam
description: Device-side software for automated image capture on Raspberry Pi, integrated with the R9lab platform. A FastAPI service captures still images with per-capture camera metadata, serves a live preview, pairs to R9lab over an outbound WebSocket relay with device-signed tokens, and uploads captures with a disk-backed retry queue.

affiliation.name: Department of Industrial Ecology, Institute of Environmental Sciences (CML), Leiden University
